what: T. Rowe Price manages money. It runs actively managed mutual funds and retirement accounts, mainly for American savers, and is one of the largest providers of target date retirement funds.
customers: Individual savers through retirement plans and brokerages, financial advisers, and institutional clients.
moat: Target date retirement funds that savers contribute to automatically every payday, which keeps money flowing in regardless of short-term performance.
risks: Money has been moving from active funds to index funds for a decade
Revenue grew only about 3% last year
Fee rates fall as competition pushes prices down
Analyst targets imply the shares are above fair value
opportunities: Operating margin of 30% with cash of $3.8 billion against almost no debt
A dividend yield near 5% with a long record of increases
Target date funds keep receiving contributions automatically
watch: Net client flows and the average fee rate on assets.
